meta.title: Subagent Dispatch
meta.description: Dispatch a subagent with a per-call preset, reasoning effort, model, provider, working directory, and output schema (dispatch_subagent tool); run one workflow with per-run settings through the single model-facing `workflow` tool, which this package serves by taking that name over inside each agent's own scope (a real redirect, never a denial); and expose an external `dispatch` subagent provider for whole-run workflow delegation. The `run_workflow` alias stays implemented but is not published by default (`exposeRunWorkflow: true` restores it).
